scope: two-backend Runtime Worker scheduler to fenced executeTeamTask end-to-end path
flow: Runtime Worker scheduler discovers and claims the task
injected actor and Control operations run executeTeamTask with the claim fence
child Runs execute through the existing Worker pool
final main Run completes and the journal records finalAccepted

verification.postgresCleanup: stopped and socket rejected a follow-up connection

limitations: Actor, authorization and Control operations are explicitly injected by the test host; production composition is still opt-in.
Process-level kill/restart, cancellation signal propagation and unknown side-effect recovery are not yet proven for the Worker scheduler path.
No default desktop Team or autonomous sub-agent activation is claimed.
